recognize_zh: 高倍率骨髓抽吸抹片中，大部分細胞是帶有豐富紫紅色顆粒的前骨髓球與骨髓球，並可見後骨髓球、桿狀及分節中性球，夾雜少數深色小圓核的紅血球母細胞；顆粒球系各階段都在且數量占優勢，就是顆粒球增生。
features: Predominance of granulocytic precursors, especially promyelocytes and myelocytes
Promyelocytes with round to oval nuclei, perinuclear hof and abundant azurophilic granules
Myelocytes and metamyelocytes with coarse secondary granules and indented nuclei
Band and segmented neutrophils present, indicating orderly maturation
Scattered small erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
No Auer rods, bundles of Auer rods or increased blasts in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a predominance of granulocytic cells, with numerous promyelocytes and myelocytes containing abundant azurophilic and secondary granules, accompanied by metamyelocytes, band forms and segmented neutrophils. Scattered erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei are interspersed. Maturation appears orderly, and Auer rods, faggot cells and increased blasts are not identified in this field. Findings are consistent with granulocytic (myeloid) hyperplasia with a left-shifted but maturing pattern; correlation with the M:E ratio, clinical history (infection, G-CSF therapy, marrow recovery) and exclusion of CML are recommended.

ddx.vs: APL shows a monotonous population of abnormal hypergranular promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and Auer rod bundles, without maturation to neutrophils.
CML also shows granulocytic hyperplasia but with basophilia, eosinophilia, small hypolobated megakaryocytes and BCR::ABL1.
Growth factor effect produces a promyelocyte/myelocyte-rich marrow with coarse granules and vacuoles; history of G-CSF use distinguishes it.
AML with maturation has 20% or more myeloblasts, often with Auer rods and dysplasia.
